# Environment Files

This folder contains environment templates and generated cloud/profile files.

- `.env.azure.example` is the Azure VM template.
- `.env.cloud.example` is the cloud-neutral template.
- `.env.azure.foundry.generated` is generated by Azure Foundry helper scripts.
- `.env.profile.generated` is generated by service profile scripts.

The root `.env` remains the active local Compose file for developer convenience and compatibility with existing `docker compose --env-file .env ...` commands.

## RAG And Embeddings

Use semantic embeddings for production retrieval and keep the local hashing model only as a deterministic fallback.

Recommended local/OpenAI profile:

```powershell
RAG_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai
OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL=text-embedding-3-small
RAG_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE=24
RAG_EMBEDDING_MAX_RETRIES=3
RAG_EMBEDDING_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS=1
```

Recommended Azure profile:

```powershell
RAG_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=azure-openai
AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_ENABLED=true
AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT=https://<resource>.openai.azure.com
AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY=<key>
AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_DEPLOYMENT=<embedding-deployment>
AZURE_AI_SEARCH_ENABLED=true
AZURE_AI_SEARCH_ENDPOINT=https://<search>.search.windows.net
AZURE_AI_SEARCH_API_KEY=<key>
AZURE_AI_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME=kaiops-rag
```

`RAG_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=auto` tries Azure OpenAI first when enabled, then OpenAI when an OpenAI key is present, then the local hashing fallback.
